mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, age, major, classp, enrol) VALUES (#{name}, #{age}, #{major}, #{classp}, #{enrol})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) as value, a.major name FROM student a GROUP BY a.major
SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name as name, cs.total_score as total_score, cs.avg_score as avg_score FROM classPro c INNER JOIN class_score cs ON c.class_id = cs.class_id
